project_name: SabziMandi Fresh - Indian Vegetables & Grocery E-Commerce

theme_strategy.primary_emotion: Farm-fresh purity, vibrant Indian market energy, trust, and effortless quick commerce efficiency
theme_strategy.target_audience: Indian household shoppers, urban families, health-conscious buyers, and local restaurant buyers needing daily fresh delivery

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.caption: text-xs font-medium tracking-wide text-emerald-800/70 dark:text-emerald-300/70

semantic.surface_card: bg-white dark:bg-[#122017] border border-emerald-900/10 dark:border-emerald-500/20 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all
semantic.primary_button: bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 active:bg-emerald-900 text-white font-semibold rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-emerald-900/20 transition-all
semantic.badge_fresh: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300/50 font-medium px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs
semantic.badge_offer: bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs shadow-sm animate-pulse
semantic.badge_organic: bg-teal-700 text-white font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_marketing: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.product_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3 sm:gap-5
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.border_padding_rule: Containers with custom borders must have at least p-4 to p-6 padding to prevent content text collision.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first_bottom_nav: Fixed bottom bar on mobile (<768px) with Home, Categories, Offers, Cart (with badge), and Account links.

key_components_to_build: HeaderNavigation: Multi-language switcher (EN/HI/KN/MR), Location Pincode Selector, Search bar with instant autocomplete, Wishlist & Cart drawer trigger
HeroBannerCarousel: High-impact fresh vegetable promotions, subscription plans, today's deals
CategoryBar: Horizontal scrollable pill list of categories (Leafy Greens, Fresh Vegetables, Exotic Fruits, Organic Combos, Indian Spices & Staples, Dairy & Bread)
ProductCard: Image with zoom hover, organic badge, weight variant selector (250g, 500g, 1kg), price breakdown (MRP vs Offer Price), direct Add button with counter (+/-)
TodayOffersSection: Countdown timer banner with flash sale prices and bundle offers
CartDrawerAndPage: Subtotal, Delivery Fee threshold progress bar ('Add ₹149 more for FREE delivery'), Coupon applying, Tip for Delivery Partner
CheckoutFlowModal: Multi-step with Address Selection (Saved / New), Slot Picker (Morning 6-9 AM, Evening 5-8 PM), Payment Mode (UPI, Razorpay, COD, Wallet)
OTPAuthModal: Phone number input with auto OTP simulation, login status sync with localStorage
WhatsAppOrderButton: Floating action button generating formatted WhatsApp purchase message to seller
CustomerAccountDashboard: Recent orders, Order tracking step indicator (Placed -> Packed -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered), Saved Addresses, Loyalty Wallet, Subscription Manager
InvoicePDFModal: Printable invoice view with GST details, itemized breakdown, and store header
AdminDashboard: Daily sales overview charts (Recharts), Low stock alerts table, Product CRUD modal, Order status modifier, Coupon manager, Customer list

micro_interactions.cart_add_pulse: Scale effect on click with spring animation using framer-motion
micro_interactions.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for toast notifications (Item added to cart, coupon applied, OTP sent, order placed)
micro_interactions.skeleton_loaders: Shimmer skeleton blocks for product grids and order list during fetch states
micro_interactions.sticky_cart_bar: Floats smoothly on mobile screens with item count and subtotal amount

data_testid_instructions.rule: All primary inputs, action buttons, links, modal toggles, and price displays MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure standard HTML/JSX components are decorated with Tailwind utility classes matching the fresh organic green theme.
Use lucide-react icons for UI elements (ShoppingCart, Search, MapPin, Phone, ShieldCheck, Tag, RefreshCw, Truck, Heart, User, Filter, ChevronDown).
Implement language dictionary for EN (English), HI (Hindi / हिंदी), KN (Kannada / ಕನ್ನಡ), and MR (Marathi / मराठी) covering nav items, labels, and checkout prompts.
Build both full Customer E-Commerce Storefront and Admin Portal seamlessly accessible via header switch/route.

Create robust sample datasets for initial load so the app is instantly rich with authentic Indian vegetables (Potaot/Aloo, Tomato/Tamatar, Onion/Pyaz, Spinach/Palak, Cauliflower/Gobi, Mango/Aam, Spices/Masala, Combos/Family Basket).
